# Pinned reference source

Unmodified source from FranciscoHS/fsec-paper at
`a9355d4001500708a40a255bacfe559e6dc269c0`, retained for inspection.
The accompanying MIT license applies to these files.

`scripts/reproduce_paper.py` obtains a sparse reference checkout with git,
checks its revision and the cached sweep's Git blob identity, runs the
original plotting script there, and refreshes these source copies.
